scope: Read saved accounts and full signal paths; inspect fixed charts; at most one causal mechanism revision; zero account backtests
history: All data already seen; exploratory attribution, not unseen or preregistered performance validation
population: All saved pv-base episodes/orders/decisions ETF17 and HK7; 27 signal histories. Price/event-exit existing accounts for comparisons only. Open-or-claim separate.
attribution: No parameter search. Retain continuous close-based MFE/MAE, final return, holding duration, inter-entry gaps, fees. Descriptive fixed MFE bands 0, 0-5%, 5-15%, >=15% for ordinary loser diagnostics; no trading thresholds inferred from bins. Attribute by symbol, year and current episode label. Reentry tags overlap other tags and are not additive.
charts: Reuse existing15 fixed cases +18 boundary windows; de-duplicate windows. Root examines complete campaigns for existing winners and dominant losses; exploratory selections declared, not acceptance test.
decision: Use broad attribution plus repeated mechanism evidence, not one scenario. No change is permitted outcome. If revise, formula frozen before signal-only comparison and all fixed cases checked.
controls: Existing no-volume and event-exit only; do not change volume multiplier, entry, risk and ranking together.
account_gate: Closed. Do not import account runner or execute portfolio simulation. Saved-result read-only arithmetic is allowed.
stop: One complete attribution, targeted chart review, zero or one change, all fixed-case review, causal checks and freeze. No second family after failure.
